ctx.x: That was during the days of the, what do you call it, the Dixie Series. We used to have Texas and Louisiana, we played at the winners from each, and we were going to Dallas. That's where you first went? That's where we stopped. Those guys had me playing my horn all night on the train, Herschel and a few of the others. And that's when we got off to Dallas. That's where Herschel separated from me, went on with the T&T band. And I had Lucien and McCarthy, Richard. And we played at one of the roughest joints in…
Now what kind of band was that that you were there, with McCarthy and Jeff?

Well they had a piano player there, and Verney Johnson was playing in front of them, boy. And they just added me to what they had there with my little group. That's why the guy picked me up for the game. And they used to add to some of the musicians that had quit him. And the trumpet player that was there before was a fellow named Frenchy. Oh yeah, Paul D. Christian.
